attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for preserving Social Security.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in the progressive, guaranteed benefit of Social Security that ensures seniors and people with disabilities receive a benefit not subject to market fluctuations or economic conditions.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to privatizing Social Security.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to raising the retirement age.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to reducing Social Security benefits earned by workers who also receive benefits from certain public retirement plans.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to repeal discriminatory laws that penalize some retired workers and their families while allowing others to receive full Social Security benefits.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The most important step to strengthen Social Security is to restore fiscal responsibility because the Bush Administration's deficits raided hundreds of billions of dollars from Social Security.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Strengthening Social Security should be a common cause for Democrats and Republicans.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
